name: Chuulverin
biography: Chuul chuulverin. A siege-engine chuul that boils the water around it, lobbing blobs of superheated sulfurous slurry that occasionally hatch into live chuuls. Habitat: Ocean.

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: The chuulverin can breathe air and water.

features.name: Sense Magic
features.description: The chuulverin senses magic within 120 feet of it at will. This trait otherwise works like the Detect Magic spell but isn't itself magical.

features.name: Siege Monster
features.description: The chuulverin deals double damage to objects and structures.

features.name: Pincer
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is Grappled (escape DC 16). While the chuulverin has two creatures Grappled in this way, it can't make Pincer attacks against other targets.

features.name: Scalding Blast
features.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 30/60 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Fire damage.

features.name: Solfatara Shot (Recharge 4-6)
features.description: The chuulverin launches a blob of sulfurous, superheated water at a point within 600 feet of it. Saving Throw: DC 15 Dexterity, each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centred on that point. Failure: 22 (4d10) Bludgeoning damage and 22 (4d10) Fire damage, which ignores Resistance to Fire damage from being underwater. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: Roll a d8. On an 8, a Chuul appears in an unoccupied space within the area. It's an ally to the chuulverin and takes its turn immediately after the chuulverin's.
